purpose_context: A project can author its own agent profile under .kittify/doctrine, and Spec Kitty loads and validates it, yet the governance cascade never sees it because the project doctrine tier admits only three kinds as graph nodes. Operators get green health checks while the authored profile silently reaches no agent. This mission closes that kind-admission gap for project-tier agent profiles so authored project governance actually reaches the dispatched agent; the asset half stays deferred.
purpose_tldr: Make hand-authored project-tier agent profiles visible to the charter cascade by emitting them as reference-graph nodes.
